name: Brief tab bar
describe: Brief app tab bar: Brief, Ask, Call. 56px plus a 34px home-indicator inset, 24px icons over 11/500 labels, active item shows a 64x32 radius-16 pill filled with the source --accent token (neutral warm gray in light, slate in dark; brief_app tokens.css) and primary-coloured icon and label. Icons reuse the app Icons.tsx glyphs (sparkle, send, phone).
Use at the bottom of the Brief PWA when voice and ask are enabled. Arabic: fixed UI labels translated (brief_app ships no Arabic locale); sample text values are illustrative.
